description: Test file for Kubernetes resource quota controller, including setup, mock discovery, and various test cases for quota synchronization and handling discovery errors.

classes.name: errorLister
classes.description: Implements cache.GenericLister that always returns errors for list and get operations.

classes.name: quotaController
classes.description: Struct holding a reference to the resource quota Controller and stop channel.

classes.name: fakeServerResources
classes.description: Mock implementation of server resources for testing discovery client behavior.

classes.name: fakeAction
classes.description: Records HTTP method, path, and query for testing request logging.

classes.name: fakeActionHandler
classes.description: Handles fake HTTP actions, returning predefined responses and recording actions.

methods.name: getResourceList
methods.description: Creates a ResourceList with specified CPU and memory quantities.

methods.name: getResourceRequirements
methods.description: Creates ResourceRequirements with specified requests and limits.

methods.name: mockDiscoveryFunc
methods.description: Returns an empty list of APIResourceList, simulating discovery.

methods.name: mockListerForResourceFunc
methods.description: Returns a function that retrieves a cache.GenericLister for a given GVR from a map.

methods.name: newGenericLister
methods.description: Creates a new cache.GenericLister populated with provided runtime objects.

methods.name: newErrorLister
methods.description: Returns an errorLister that always errors on list/get.

methods.name: setupQuotaController
methods.description: Initializes and starts a quota controller with provided client, lister, and discovery function.

methods.name: newTestPods
methods.description: Returns a list of test Pod objects with different statuses.

methods.name: newBestEffortTestPods
methods.description: Returns a list of test Pods with best-effort QoS class.

methods.name: newTestPodsWithPriorityClasses
methods.description: Returns a list of test Pods with assigned priority classes.

methods.name: TestSyncResourceQuota
methods.description: Test case for syncing resource quotas with various scenarios and expected actions.

methods.name: TestAddQuota
methods.description: Test case for adding quotas and verifying queue states based on quota status.

methods.name: TestDiscoverySync
methods.description: Test that ensures discovery client errors do not block quota controller sync.

methods.name: assertMonitors
methods.description: Checks that the quota monitor has the expected resources being monitored.

methods.name: testServerAndClientConfig
methods.description: Creates a test HTTP server and corresponding REST config.

methods.name: expectSyncNotBlocked
methods.description: Verifies that the discovery client is called and worker lock is not blocked.
